hints.title: Group Times by Name
hints.text: Map each person to their list of access timestamps converted to total minutes from midnight.

hints.title: Sort Timestamps
hints.text: Sort the access minutes for each person in non-decreasing chronological order.

hints.title: Sliding Difference Check
hints.text: For each person, check if any timestamp at index i plus two occurs within 60 minutes of index i.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of keyName array
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all triplets for every employee without sorting takes quadratic time per employee.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grouping and sorting timestamps takes O(n log n) time and O(n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should convert HH:MM to integer minutes for clean window difference comparison.
